channel.title: CLI :: Gonemaster
channel.description: This page documents gonemaster, the direct local test runner. It runs the engine in the current process without gonemaster-server. gonemaster normalizes IDN domains to IDNA A-labels before use. This page is for the local runner only. The server client is documented under client/ , including job and batch operations. Installation Install the CLI with Go: go install codeberg.org/pawal/gonemaster/cmd/gonemaster@latest For local development from a checkout: go build -o gonemaster ./cmd/gonemaster Synopsis gonemaster [flags] [DOMAIN] Notes:
